pricingWhyCard3Body: More structured matching—often less flexibility on choosing the teacher, pricing, and direct relationships.
pricingWhyCard4Body: Local discovery, trusted profiles, booking, payment, progress, and a resolution center in one experience.
pricingPageCommissionTitle: A commission that can decrease with your volume
pricingPageCommissionSubtitle: The more you teach on Pratiqo, the more your tier can improve.
pricingPageCommissionFootnote: Based on cumulative annual volume. Rates may change according to applicable terms.
pricingPageBreakevenTitle: Pro makes sense when you teach regularly
pricingPageBreakevenLead: Pro lowers commission by 5 percentage points at the Bronze tier. Around $600 in monthly lesson volume, that savings can offset the monthly Pro fee.
pricingPageBreakevenDisclaimer: Example only. Results depend on your volume, rates, and tier.
pricingPageValueCard1Desc: Lesson payments handled safely from start to finish.
pricingPageValueCard3Desc: Discovery built around proximity and trust.
pricingPageValueCard4Desc: Progress and activity in one place.
pricingPageValueCard5Desc: Help when something needs a fair outcome.
pricingPageValueCard6Desc: Quality, reliability, and new features over time.
pricingPageRevenueLead: Pratiqo earns mainly when a lesson is completed and paid. Teachers can also choose Pro to lower commission and unlock advanced tools.
pricingPageFaq1A: No. Students don’t need a platform subscription to book lessons.
pricingPageFaq2Q: Is the listed price what I pay?
pricingPageFaq2A: Yes—for the lesson. The price shown is what you pay at checkout, without an extra platform fee from Pratiqo.
pricingPageFaq3A: Pratiqo keeps a percentage on completed, paid lessons. Your rate depends on Free vs Pro and your annual volume tier.
pricingPageFaq4Q: Why does Pratiqo charge a commission?
pricingPageFaq4A: It funds discovery, booking, payments, receipts, trust signals, and support.
pricingPageFaq5A: When your lesson volume means the lower Pro commission saves more than the monthly fee—often around $600/month as a rough guide, not a promise.
pricingPageFaq6A: Yes. Billed monthly; cancellation applies at the end of the current period; no prorated refund.
pricingPageFaq7Q: How do Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Platinum work?
pricingPageFaq7A: Your tier reflects rolling annual lesson volume on Pratiqo. As volume grows, your rate can move to the published tiers.
pricingPageFaq8A: Timing depends on payout processing, account status, and any required checks—not a single fixed payday for everyone.
pricingPageFaq9Q: What if there’s a problem with a lesson?
pricingPageFaq9A: Use the resolution center so we can help coordinate a fair outcome.
